value.rationale: Strengthen the ordinary raw-source compiler with reusable clause inheritance, actor/recipient separation, explicit exception binding, normalized endpoint triggers, action-specific disposal parsing, and contextual post-disposal retention detection. The update repairs the four acquisition parents without changing the locked planner, consumer, operations, or language rules.
source_functions:
def ft_permission_context(valid,index):
    uid,text=valid[index]
    context=text
    support=[uid]
    direct=ft_permission_clause(text)
    recipients=ft_recipient_classes(text,['receiving_party'])
    if not direct:
        if recipients is None:
            return None
        j=max(0,index-3)
        head=None
        while j<index:
            ptext=valid[j][1]
            if ft_permission_clause(ptext) and ptext.rstrip().endswith(':'):
                head=j
            j+=1
        if head is None:
            return None
        context=valid[head][1]+' '+text
        support=[valid[head][0],uid]
    elif recipients is None or text.rstrip().endswith(':'):
        j=index+1
        while j<len(valid) and j<=index+4:
            nuid,ntext=valid[j]
            combined=context+' '+ntext
            if ft_recipient_classes(combined,['receiving_party']) is not None:
                context=combined
                support.append(nuid)
                break
            nlow=ft_norm(ntext)
            if re.match(r'^\s*\d+\.\s+[a-z]',nlow) and not re.match(r'^\s*\d+\.\d+',nlow):
                break
            j+=1
    if ft_recipient_classes(context,['receiving_party']) is None:
        return None
    j=index+1
    while j<len(valid) and j<=index+4:
        nuid,ntext=valid[j]
        nlow=ft_norm(ntext)
        qualified=('bound' in nlow or 'obliged' in nlow or 'obligated' in nlow or 'comply with this agreement' in nlow or 'confidentiality agreement' in nlow)
        referent=('representative' in nlow or 'employee' in nlow or 'anyone to whom' in nlow or 'persons to whom' in nlow or 'recipient' in nlow)
        if qualified and referent:
            context=context+' '+ntext
            if nuid not in support:
                support.append(nuid)
        j+=1
    return [context,support]

def ft_disposal_action(text,receiver,discloser):
    low=ft_norm(text)
    if 'return receipt' in low:
        return None
    survival=('continue to be bound' in low or 'shall survive' in low or 'duties of confidentiality' in low and 'survive' in low)
    if survival:
        return None
    protected=('confidential' in low or 'information' in low or 'document' in low or 'material' in low or 'copies' in low or 'reproduction' in low or 'record' in low or 'file' in low)
    if not protected:
        return None
    return_word=('return' in low or 'deliver to' in low)
    destroy_word=('destroy' in low or 'delete' in low or 'erase' in low)
    operative=('shall' in low or 'must' in low or 'return or destroy' in low or 'destroy or return' in low or 'returned or destroyed' in low or 'shall be returned' in low or 'immediately return' in low)
    retention_only=('may retain' in low or 'may be retained' in low or 'entitled to retain' in low or 'not be required to delete' in low)
    if retention_only and not ('shall return' in low or 'shall destroy' in low or 'return or destroy' in low):
        return None
    if not operative or (not return_word and not destroy_word):
        return None
    has_return=return_word and 'destruction will be confirmed' not in low
    has_destroy=destroy_word and 'not destroyed' not in low
    ci=['confidential_information']
    copies=['copies_of',ci]
    material=ft_material_scope(text)
    returned=['return_to',material,discloser]
    destroyed=['destroy',material]
    if has_return and has_destroy and ('and immediately destroy all compilations' in low or 'and immediately destroy all compilations, analysis' in low):
        base=['information_bundle',ci,copies]
        alternative=['source_action_alternative',['return_to',base,discloser],['destroy',base],text]
        return ['source_action_conjunction',alternative,['destroy',['derivative_materials_of',ci]],text]
    if has_return and has_destroy and ('where expressly authorised in writing' in low or 'where expressly authorized in writing' in low):
        return ['source_authorized_action_alternative',returned,destroyed,text]
    alternative=('return or destroy' in low or 'returned or destroyed' in low or 'destroy or return' in low or 'return (or destroy' in low or 'or destroyed' in low or 'or destroy it' in low or 'either (i)' in low or 'either (1)' in low or 'or certify the destruction' in low)
    if has_return and has_destroy and alternative:
        return ['source_action_alternative',returned,destroyed,text]
    if has_return and has_destroy:
        destroy_material=material
        destroy_pos=low.find('destroy')
        if destroy_pos<0:
            destroy_pos=low.find('erase')
        if destroy_pos>=0:
            tail=low[destroy_pos:]
            if ('copies' in tail or 'reproductions' in tail) and 'confidential information' not in tail:
                destroy_material=copies
        return ['source_action_conjunction',returned,['destroy',destroy_material],text]
    if has_return:
        return returned
    return destroyed
